You are an expert Roblox game developer and game designer.

Create a complete, professional Roblox game called "MonsterVerse."

GAME GENRE
- Open-world monster collecting adventure
- Exploration RPG
- Mobile and PC optimized
- Bright, colorful low-poly Roblox style
- Smooth performance (60 FPS target)
- Beginner-friendly progression
- Highly expandable for future updates

==================================================
CORE GAMEPLAY LOOP
==================================================

Spawn
↓

Explore the world

↓

Find wild monsters

↓

Catch monsters

↓

Gain coins and XP

↓

Upgrade equipment

↓

Unlock new areas

↓

Discover rarer monsters

↓

Complete monster collection

↓

Become the strongest trainer

==================================================
WORLD 1
==================================================

Create a beautiful forest world approximately 250x250 studs.

Include:

• Spawn Village
• Shop
• Quest NPC
• Monster Research Lab
• Slime Meadow
• Dense Forest
• Flower Field
• River
• Pond
• Waterfall
• Wooden Bridge
• Cave Entrance
• Ancient Tree
• Small Hills
• Dirt Paths
• Cliffs around map edges

The map should feel alive and encourage exploration.

==================================================
ART STYLE
==================================================

Low-poly

Cartoon

Bright colors

Stylized

Rounded edges

Premium Roblox quality

Soft lighting

Future Lighting

Atmosphere

Bloom

Sun Rays

Color Correction

Animated grass

Wind effects

Particle effects

==================================================
MONSTERS
==================================================

Create reusable monster framework.

Starter monsters:

Green Slime
Blue Slime
Bee
Bunny
Fox

Each monster includes:

Unique model

Idle animation

Walk animation

Run animation

Spawn animation

Catch animation

Respawn animation

Unique sounds

Unique stats

==================================================
AI
==================================================

Every monster should:

Idle

Look around

Random wandering

Avoid obstacles

Stay inside spawn radius

Use PathfindingService

Detect players

Watch nearby players

Run away when threatened

Return to wandering

Respawn after being caught

All AI should use reusable state machines.

==================================================
MONSTER DATA
==================================================

Each monster stores:

Name

Description

Health

Speed

Run Speed

Level

XP Reward

Coin Reward

Catch Chance

Respawn Time

Rarity

Biome

Favorite Weather

Favorite Time

==================================================
RARITIES
==================================================

Common

Uncommon

Rare

Epic

Legendary

Mythic

Secret

Divine

Celestial

==================================================
PLAYER
==================================================

Player has:

Coins

Gems

XP

Level

Inventory

Monster Collection

Quest Progress

Achievements

Settings

Statistics

==================================================
CATCHING SYSTEM
==================================================

Player approaches monster

Press E

Play catch animation

Play sound

Particle effects

Monster disappears

Monster added to inventory

Coins and XP awarded

Monster respawns after timer

==================================================
INVENTORY
==================================================

Grid inventory

Monster cards

Search bar

Sorting

Filters

Equip

Favorite

Delete

View stats

==================================================
SHOP
==================================================

Sell monsters

Capture capsules

Backpack upgrades

Speed upgrades

Cosmetics

Gamepasses

Bundles

Daily deals

==================================================
QUESTS
==================================================

Daily

Weekly

Story

Side quests

Rewards

Progress bars

Quest tracking

==================================================
ACHIEVEMENTS
==================================================

Catch monsters

Earn coins

Reach levels

Unlock worlds

Find secrets

Complete collection

==================================================
SAVE SYSTEM
==================================================

Use DataStoreService.

Save:

Coins

XP

Level

Inventory

Monster collection

Achievements

Quest progress

Settings

==================================================
USER INTERFACE
==================================================

Top:

Coins

Gems

XP Bar

Level

Bottom:

Inventory

Monsters

Shop

Quests

Map

Settings

Buttons should have:

Hover animation

Click animation

Sound effects

Rounded design

Glassmorphism

Mobile responsive

==================================================
AUDIO
==================================================

Forest ambience

Birds

Wind

River

Waterfall

Monster sounds

Button clicks

Coins

Quest complete

Level up

==================================================
PERFORMANCE
==================================================

StreamingEnabled

LOD friendly

Optimized scripts

Object pooling

Efficient AI

Low memory usage

Mobile optimized

==================================================
CODE QUALITY
==================================================

Use ModuleScripts.

Separate client and server logic.

Use RemoteEvents and RemoteFunctions securely.

Write clean, well-commented, modular Lua code.

Organize folders professionally.

Avoid duplicated code.

==================================================
FUTURE EXPANSION
==================================================

Design every system to support:

100+ monsters

20+ worlds

Trading

Evolution

Bosses

Guilds

Raids

PvP

Seasonal events

Weather system

Day/night cycle

Crafting

Mounts

Pets

==================================================
FINAL GOAL
==================================================

Build a polished, expandable Roblox game that feels like a premium monster-collecting adventure with smooth gameplay, professional UI, reusable systems, optimized performance, and a strong foundation for long-term updates.

answers.ask: Are the Shop, Monster Research Lab and Cave actually entered, or interacted with from outside? Interiors change the build route.
answers.answer: Use simple enterable interiors for the Shop and Monster Research Lab, and make the Cave a short accessible cave area entered through its entrance.

scene_prompt: Create a bright, colorful low-poly open-world monster-collecting adventure map, World 1, approximately 250x250 studs. Build a Spawn Village as the central hub, with a simple enterable Shop and Monster Research Lab, plus a Quest NPC area. Dirt paths lead outward through a Slime Meadow, dense forest, and flower field, connecting small hills, an ancient tree landmark, a river with a wooden bridge, a pond, and a waterfall. Place a cave entrance leading into a short accessible cave area. Enclose the outer edges with cliffs, with the major biomes and landmarks distributed to encourage exploration. Use rounded stylized terrain, bright foliage, soft atmospheric lighting, and subtle animated grass, wind, and environmental particle effects.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Adventure, with RPG secondary. Exploration, discovery, and collecting lead the brief; XP, levels, equipment upgrades, and unlockable areas provide RPG progression.

## Shape and preset
Use `world-open` as one contiguous 250-by-250-stud World 1 with an attached short cave interior. The preset is Exploration, retaining its trails, focal landmark, and discovery spaces while adding the stated village services and monster habitats.

## Config requirements
Use `path-trail` for dirt paths radiating from Spawn Village through the meadow, forest, and flower field. Use `landmark-focal` for the ancient tree and waterfall as orientation anchors. Treat the short cave as `alcove-secret`, an optional discovery pocket off the main exploration network. Add `building-interior` for the enterable Shop, Monster Research Lab, and cave transition. Use `npc-population` for the Quest NPC and five starter monster species—Green Slime, Blue Slime, Bee, Bunny, and Fox. Include `water-body` for river, pond, and waterfall and `terrain-relief` for small hills and enclosing cliffs.

## Layout requirements
Place the functional half of `npc-population` at the Quest NPC area and as habitat markers for all five starter species. Put slime markers in Slime Meadow, bees in the flower field, bunnies at meadow-forest edges, foxes in denser woods, and reserve multiple separated points for both slime colors. Add catch-and-respawn spawn points inside each habitat radius. Place one player spawn in the village, and link doors for the Shop and Lab plus the cave entrance to their interior arrivals.

## Layout components
Build a roughly 250-by-250-stud cliff-bounded world. Spawn Village occupies the center with Shop, Research Lab, and Quest NPC area. Dirt paths branch to Slime Meadow, dense forest, flower field, small hills, ancient tree, river crossing, pond, waterfall, and cave entrance. One wooden bridge crosses the river. The cave is short and accessible rather than a deep dungeon. Use rounded low-poly ground, bright foliage, animated grass, and subtle wind and particles. Keep every biome reachable from the hub and frame the ancient tree and waterfall as distant navigational pulls.

## Render order
Use `isometric`: the premium colorful world look leads, and its top-down is projected afterward because the exploration network needs clarity but not generated maze or circuit validity.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
The scale is medium, fixed by 250 by 250 studs. The theme is bright rounded low-poly fantasy forest with soft atmosphere. Use `P3` for entered buildings and cave, `P2` because the cave lies beneath enclosing terrain, `tiered` for hills and cliffs, and `CHECK` for the river, pond, and waterfall.
